label: September 14–20, 2026
intro: Glide into the week with ice, clay, and Marvel magic — there's something hands-on for Thor every day!
weekday_note: Weekdays are perfect for the planetarium English show (Tuesdays 10am) and a midweek skate at The Rink.

activities.title: Ice Skating at The Rink Central World
activities.location: The Rink, Central World (BTS Chit Lom)
activities.price: 350 THB weekday / 450 THB weekend (skate rental included)
activities.why: Thor loves skating — practice penguins keep little ones balanced while pros skate circles around them. Weekend sessions are buzzing with energy.
activities.tip: Arrive right when it opens on Saturday to skip the queue. Bring warm socks!

activities.title: Library Storytime & Craft at Neilson Hays
activities.why: Themed stories followed by a hands-on craft activity — perfect builder/maker morning for Thor.
activities.tip: Arrive 10 mins early — seats fill up fast. Check their Facebook for the week's theme.

activities.title: Kids Pottery Workshop at Clay Circle BKK
activities.location: Clay Circle BKK, Block 28 Creative Village (near MRT Samyan)
activities.why: Thor loved pottery — wheel throwing and hand-building classes for age 5+, perfect for his building & making interest.
activities.tip: Book online in advance — weekend slots sell out. Wear clothes you don't mind getting clay on.

activities.title: The Marvel Experience Thailand
activities.location: Bang Phli, Samut Prakan (30 min from central Bangkok)
activities.price: Book on Klook for best price (~500–800 THB)
activities.why: Iron Man, Thor, Captain America — 20+ Marvel heroes in immersive 3D/4D environments. Thor will absolutely lose his mind here.
activities.tip: Weekends get busy. Book Klook tickets in advance for a discount. Grab a Grab car — it's about 200–300 THB each way.

activities.title: Planetarium English Show — Science Center for Education
activities.location: Science Center for Education, Sukhumvit Soi 40 (BTS Ekkamai area)
activities.price: Museum: ~50 THB adult / 30 THB child; Planetarium: +50 THB adult / +30 THB child
activities.why: 360-degree star show with surround sound — space science for little explorers. Four interactive museum buildings to explore after.
activities.tip: Tuesday English shows are the only English-language screenings. Arrive early to grab good seats in the dome.

activities.title: Roller Dome at Emporium
activities.location: Emporium Shopping Mall, Sukhumvit Soi 24 (BTS Phrom Phong)
activities.why: Southeast Asia's largest rink with professional trainers — perfect for Thor's rollerblading passion. Experienced coaches for beginners.
activities.tip: Hire an instructor for 30 mins to give Thor a boost — they're great with young kids.

activities.title: Children's Discovery Museum (Chatuchak)
activities.location: Chatuchak Park, near MRT Chatuchak Park / BTS Mo Chit
activities.why: Huge hands-on interactive exhibits covering science, nature, and creativity — Thor can build, explore, and discover for hours.
activities.tip: Go on a weekday to avoid weekend crowds. Combine with a quick browse of Chatuchak Weekend Market on Saturday.

activities.title: A Little Something Kids Cooking Class
activities.why: Thailand's first bilingual kids cooking school — Thor gets to make real food with his own hands. Menu rotates so every visit is new.
activities.tip: The Sukhumvit 49 branch is most popular. Classes fill up fast — book at least a week ahead.
